exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.detail: Slow movement to warm up the spine.
steps: Start on hands and knees with wrists under shoulders
Inhale, arch your back and lift your head and tailbone (Cow pose)
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin to your chest (Cat pose)
Flow smoothly between these two positions
Keep movements slow and controlled

exercises.name: Hip Circles
exercises.detail: Mobilize the hips in both directions.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands on hips
Make large circles with your hips clockwise
Complete 8 circles going clockwise
Reverse direction and make 8 circles counterclockwise
Keep your core engaged and upper body stable

exercises.name: Shoulder Rolls
exercises.detail: Improve upper body mobility and posture.
steps: Stand or sit with arms relaxed at your sides
Roll shoulders forward in a circular motion
Complete 10 forward rolls
Reverse direction and roll shoulders backward
Keep movements slow and deliberate

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
steps: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides
Jump while spreading legs wide and raising arms overhead
Jump back to starting position
Repeat continuously at a steady pace
Land softly on the balls of your feet

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.detail: Drive knees toward chest at a steady pace.
steps: Start in a high plank position with hands under shoulders
Drive one knee toward your chest
Quickly switch legs, extending the other leg back
Continue alternating legs at a fast pace
Keep your core tight and hips level

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.detail: Maintain a quick rhythm with tall posture.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart
Run in place, lifting knees as high as possible
Pump your arms in running motion
Land on the balls of your feet
Maintain a quick, steady rhythm throughout

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.detail: Hold weight at chest and squat deeply.
steps: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell at chest level
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart
Push your hips back and bend knees to lower into squat
Keep chest up and core engaged
Push through heels to return to standing

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.detail: Pull weight toward hip with control.
steps: Place one knee and hand on a bench for support
Hold dumbbell in opposite hand with arm extended
Pull dumbbell up to your hip, squeezing shoulder blade
Lower with control back to starting position
Complete all reps on one side, then switch

exercises.name: Plank Hold
steps: Start in forearm plank position
Keep elbows directly under shoulders
Engage your core and keep body in straight line
Don't let hips sag or pike up
Hold position while breathing steadily

exercises.name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie on your back with arms extended toward ceiling
Lift legs with knees bent at 90 degrees
Lower opposite arm and leg toward floor slowly
Return to starting position with control
Alternate sides keeping core engaged throughout

exercises.name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side with legs extended
Place forearm on ground under shoulder
Lift hips off the ground, forming straight line
Engage core and hold position
Complete hold time, then switch to other side

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat
Push through heels to lift hips toward ceiling
Squeeze glutes at the top of the movement
Lower hips back down with control
Keep core engaged throughout the movement
